{Black should play d6 to attack White's knight before capturing on e4. How can
White win material?} 4. Qe2 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] 
[%hint Use your queen to attack on the open e-file.]} (4. d4 $2 d5 {Black is
OK. Try to find a stronger move.}) (4. Qf3 $2 Nf6 {Black is OK. Try to find a
better move.}) 4... Nf6 {Good start! Black should have played Qe7, which only
lets White emerge with an extra pawn. Now White has a famous trap which wins
the black queen. What should you play?} 5. Nc6+ {[%wrong There's a better move.
Try to find it.] [%hint Attack the black queen with discovered check.]} (5.
Ng6+ $5 {White wins material, but there's an even better option. Try to find
it.}) (5. Nxf7+ $2 Kxf7 {Black is winning. Try again.}) 5... Qe7 {Great move!
What's next?} 6. Nxe7 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try to find it.] [%hint
Capture the queen with your knight.] Great job! White is winning.} (6. Qxe7+ $2
Bxe7 {That's just an even trade. Try to find a better capture.}) *

{When White is able to open the g-file to attack, Black has a difficult
defense ahead. What's the only move that keeps Black in the game?} 16... Re6 {
[%wrong White has a winning attack. Try again and check the hint if you're
stuck.] [%hint Defend the sixth rank to prepare a way to evict the h6-bishop.]}
(16... Kh8 $2 17. Rxg7 {This was played in Shirov - Bogner 2017, but White had
a winning attack. Try again and look for a better defensive move.}) (16... g6
$2 17. h5 {White will open the kingside with a deadly attack. Try again and
check the hint if you're stuck.}) (16... bxc5 $2 17. Rxg7+ {White sacrifices
for a winning kingside attack. Try again and check the hint if you're stuck.})
(16... Kf8 $2 17. Rxg7 {White sacrifices for a winning kingside attack. Try
again and check the hint if you're stuck.}) 17. Bxg7 {Great move! White would
have been better off retreating the h6-bishop. How should Black win material?}
Bxg7 {[%wrong White has a winning attack. Try again and look for a good
defensive option.] [%hint Recapture on the kingside.] Great work! White has no
way to safely add attackers to the g7-bishop and Black should soon convert the
extra piece into a win.} *

{How did GM Alexei Shirov break open the black kingside?} 17. Rxg7 {[%wrong
There's a better attacking option. Try again and look for a winning sacrifice.]
[%hint Sacrifice a rook to expose the black king.]} (17. Bxg7+ $5 {This is a
great move, but Shirov preferred another sacrifice on g7. What did he play?}) (
17. cxb6 $2 axb6 {Back opens the a-file with a good position. Try again and
look for a stronger attacking move.}) (17. Bg5 $2 bxc5 {Black wins a pawn with
a good position. Try again and look for a stronger attacking option.}) (17. Bf4
$2 bxc5 {Black wins a pawn with a good position. Try again and look for a
stronger attacking option.}) (17. Bxh7 $2 Kxh7 {It's much stronger to
sacrifice on the dark squares around the black king. How should you do it?})
17... Bxg7 {Great start! How can you continue the attack?} 18. Bxg7+ {[%wrong
Black has a winning material advantage. Try again and look for a way to force
the black king into danger.] [%hint Sacrifice to make the black king come to
the g-file.]} (18. Rg1 $2 Rg8 {Black is doing well. Try again and look for a
more forcing attacking option.}) 18... Kxg7 {Great work! How should White hunt
down the black king?} 19. Rg1+ {[%wrong There's a better attacking option. Try
again and look for a winning check.] [%hint Find a winning check on the g-file.
]} (19. Qg5+ $2 Qxg5+ {Black will win the endgame after a trade of queens. Try
again and look for a stronger check.}) (19. Qc3+ $2 f6 {Black is doing well.
Try again and look for a better check.}) 19... Bg4 {Good idea! Keep it up.} 20.
Rxg4+ {[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Try again and look for a good
capture.] [%hint Capture a piece with check.]} (20. fxg4 $2 Qxh4 {White
doesn't have enough compensation for the lost material. Try again and look for
a stronger capture.}) 20... Kf8 {Well played! How should you force the black
king into the open?} 21. Qh6+ {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and
look for a good check.] [%hint Check and force the black king to the e-file.]
Well played! Every white piece joins the attack and Black soon resigned in
Shirov - Bogner 2017.} (21. Qf4 $5 {This is a good move, but Shirov found an
even better square for the queen. What did he play?}) (21. Bxh7 $2 Qf6 {
White has compensation for the sacrificed exchange, but no more. Try again and
look for a better attacking option.}) *

is enough play to hold a draw. What should you play?} 8. Qe2 {[%wrong There's
a stronger attacking option. Try again and look for a strong pin.] [%hint Pin
the e4-knight against Black's king.]} (8. Qxd5 $2 Ndf6 {Black is doing well.

is doing well. Try again and look for a way to make a useful pin.}) (8. Bg5+ $2
Nxg5 {Black is doing well. Try again and look for a way to make a useful pin.})
(8. Qh4+ $2 Ndf6 {Black is doing well. Try again and look for a way to make a
useful pin.}) 8... Kf7 {Great move! How should you keep Black's king on the
run?} 9. Qh5+ {[%wrong Black is doing well. Try again and look for a good
attacking option.] [%hint Fork the black king and an undefended pawn.] Good
work! Black must bring the king to the e-file and after Qe2 the game will
likely end with a draw by repetition.} (9. Qf3+ $2 Ndf6 {Black keeps a
material advantage. Try again and look for a good check.}) (9. Bxe4 $2 dxe4 {
Black keeps a material advantage. Try again and look for a good check.}) (9. f3
$2 Qh4+ {Black has a winning attack. Try again and look for a useful check.}) *
